changelog:
Browsing stays fast in very large catalogs after every refresh, and Settings' notice about a failed index rebuild is more reliable.

WHAT CHANGED

- After each refresh the app records how large each provider, category and series really is, so the database picks the quick way to read a list on its own. Before, it estimated every list as the same size and needed fixed hints to choose well; the hints stay as a second line.
- If a background index rebuild fails, Settings keeps saying so until a later rebuild succeeds, even if you start another refresh meanwhile. A rebuild stuck behind a long import now gives up after 7 minutes and reports, instead of trying again and again without a word.
- If an import is interrupted while it is setting the indexes aside, they are always rebuilt at the next start.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.6.3: a category in a catalog of a million channels or more opens in a few milliseconds.
